_readme: Copy to settings.json (git-ignored). Interpreter paths may be relative to this folder: the README creates the environments with `conda create -p envs\<name>`, which gives envs\brain\python.exe and so on; absolute paths to any other environments work too. brain = Python 3.11 + brain/requirements.txt; speech = Python 3.11 + CUDA torch + speech/requirements.txt (also runs the Discord/Telegram service); embedder = its own env with CUDA torch + brain/requirements-embedder.txt (BAAI/bge-m3 downloads into the Hugging Face cache on its first start, about 2.3 GB). The optional vision block gives her eyes: a small local VLM (vision/requirements.txt) that describes your camera feed; leave enabled:false to run without it.

vision._models: qwen3-vl-2b (~4.3 GB VRAM, zh/en/ja, default) | qwen3-vl-4b (~9 GB, sharper but slow on some stacks) | qwen2.5-vl-3b (~7.6 GB) | smolvlm2-2.2b (~5 GB, EN) | smolvlm2-500m (~1.2 GB, tiny EN)

services._readme: Optional. Programs the launcher starts in its one console (and stops with Ctrl+C). Paths relative to this folder. health = URL answering when up, or port = TCP port opening when up; after = start once that service is up. A service already running is used as is.

tts._readme: The OpenAmika voice server (vendor/tts-engine, a MekaHime build of GPT-SoVITS) with Amika's voice. python scripts/setup_tts.py installs both; until then the launcher reports this command missing and she answers in text only. Keep --character in step with tts_character.
